payload.title: FUN-work: public-process proof for Work after INV→CLN→DEL vertical completion
payload.ask: After INV-WORK-TOPLEVEL, CLN-WORK-FOLD-SERVICE, CLN-WORK-LEGACY-PACKAGES, CLN-WORK-CONTRACT-ROOTS, and DEL-WORK Factory completion, prove from an external-user perspective that Work still works: submission (unary/batch/HTTP), routing/classifier/logical-move, relationships (DEPENDS_ON/PARENT_CHILD), recovery/manual-move, recordings-read, CLI submit contracts, and visualization/dependency-graph surfaces remain inert until runtime lifecycle, then activate through public Work protocol surfaces constructed only via root.BuildProcess and edges.Edges—without inventing root/wire test subsystems or peer-importing work/internal or deleted transitional Work packages (service/, stateaccessrecordings/, legacy pkg/work public roots).
systemShapeRequirements: Keep packaged Work root as wire/, internal/, transports/ plus thin root contracts; do not fold or delete packages in this packet (residual public testdata/ is inventory debt, not this packet's deletion scope)
Do not invent new pkg/root or pkg/wire Work helper APIs solely for tests
Functional proofs construct the process only through root.BuildProcess and replace effects only via edges.Edges
Do not invent Work HTTP/CLI/MCP adapters (Work adapters already Factory-terminal) or reopen accepted Schema-Driven/Clean CLI UX
Do not revive deleted pkg/work transitional roots or reopen CLN-WORK / DEL-WORK deletion leases
testCoverageRequirements: Own proofs under tests/functional/work (existing submission/, routing/, relationships/, recovery/, recordings/, transports/cli/submit/, visualization/, cli/ suites are the primary home)

First validate whether existing functional proofs already cover inert construction and post-lifecycle activation for submission, routing, relationships, recovery, recordings-read, CLI submit contracts, and visualization; add only missing external proofs
Do not substitute packaged_root_shape, del_work_* gate tests, peer-import scanners, or unit-only thin-root proofs for external behavior proof
Do not invent a new peer/root/wire Work test subsystem or a second suite topology outside tests/functional/work
acceptanceCriteria: Submission, routing/relationships, recovery/manual-move, recordings-read, and CLI submit contract surfaces have external functional proof of inert construction and post-lifecycle activation through public Work surfaces (behavioral)
No functional-suite or production peer import of deleted Work transitional packages (service/, stateaccessrecordings/, legacy pkg/work public roots) or work/internal from outside the Work owner
Packaged Work root remains wire/, internal/, transports/ plus thin root contracts (testdata/ may remain as committed unexpected move debt only)
Typecheck, lint, and required CI are terminal green; PR merged before Factory completion
outOfScope: New pkg/root or pkg/wire Work composition helpers created only to make tests compile
Package fold/delete under pkg/services/work/** (including testdata/ burn-down)
FUN-settings / FUN-workers / FUN-recordings / FUN-definitions / FUN-runtime (separate owner gates)
Reopening CLN-WORK or DEL-WORK deletion leases
antiPatterns: Treating DEL-WORK merge alone as FUN-work complete without public-process proof
Building a root/wire 'WorkRootFromEdges' subsystem because tests asked for public composition
Treating packaged_root_shape or del_work_* unit gates as sufficient FUN proof without external lifecycle behavior
Peer-importing work/internal or deleted transitional Work packages from functional suites
Inventing protocol adapters or reopening accepted CLI UX under a FUN lease
Folding/deleting testdata/ or other residual dirs under a FUN lease
Touching live Providers CLI adapter, WRK/REC/SET/DEF CLN-DEL lanes, FUN-runtime, CUT-RUN-REC, or PSS-I0* under a FUN lease
currentProgress: INV-WORK-TOPLEVEL, CLN-WORK-FOLD-SERVICE, CLN-WORK-LEGACY-PACKAGES, CLN-WORK-CONTRACT-ROOTS, and DEL-WORK are Factory-terminal (DEL-WORK PR #1641 merged fdeb6696f; idea/plan/task/review complete).

Live pkg/services/work public directories are wire/, internal/, transports/, plus residual unexpected testdata/; service/ and stateaccessrecordings/ are gone; packaged_root_shape / del_work_* gates lock the deletion.

Existing tests/functional/work covers submission, routing, relationships, recovery, recordings-read, CLI submit contracts, and visualization; FUN must validate/extend those for public-process inertness + lifecycle, not invent a second suite topology.
Work HTTP/CLI/MCP adapters are already Factory-terminal; FUN closes the vertical with explicit public-process proof.
Customer ask after this wave prefers FUN-work when prerequisites are clear; free executor capacity exists while other owner CLN/DEL lanes progress naturally.
changedPathLease: pkg/services/work/** root contract/characterization tests only when required for public-process proof gaps
exclude Providers CLI adapter lease and Workers/Settings/Recordings/Definitions residual CLN/DEL leases
payload.requestedOutcome: Prove Work as a packaged service through public process composition only: root.BuildProcess, public Work protocol surfaces (HTTP/CLI/MCP adapters already terminal), and edges.Edges effect replacement. Validate and, only where needed, extend focused functional proofs under tests/functional/work so submission (unary/batch/HTTP), routing/classifier/logical-move, relationships, recovery/manual-move, recordings-read, CLI submit contracts, and visualization/dependency-graph remain inert until runtime lifecycle starts, then exercise public Work behavior without importing work/internal or deleted transitional Work packages (service/, stateaccessrecordings/, legacy pkg/work public roots) from outside the owner and without inventing pkg/root or pkg/wire test-only composition helpers. Confirm no production peer reaches Work through deleted transitional packages. Do not fold or delete packages (including residual testdata/). Do not invent Work protocol adapters or reopen accepted Schema-Driven/Clean CLI UX. Do not open PSS-I0* shared integrators. Delivery contract: loop implementation and review until required CI is terminal green, every blocking PR conversation comment is addressed, merge conflicts and shared-file churn are reconciled, the PR is merged, and only then complete Factory work.

payload.title: Meta-planner follow-up after FUN-work
payload.requestedOutcome: After FUN-work reaches Factory complete, reconcile inventories, functional coverage, and queue/session/PR/CI evidence and repair any stranded merged tasks. Prefer FUN-settings after Settings DEL, FUN-workers after Workers DEL, and FUN-recordings after Recordings DEL when prerequisites clear. Prefer remaining WRK/REC/SET/DEF CLN/DEL progress and FUN-definitions only after DEL-DEF and DEL-DEF-RESIDUAL. Prefer FUN-runtime/CUT-RUN-REC loopback outcomes when those terminals land. Prefer Providers CLI adapter loopback when CLI-PROV is terminal (HTTP/MCP already terminal). Hold IMP-WRK-07 while hosted_logic remains polling-only; hold PSS-I0*. Do not invent WRK protocol adapters or reopen accepted CLI UX. Do not revive deleted Work transitional packages. Refill maximum safe throughput toward executor-slot capacity 16 from the live ready set.
